hooks.command: LOG_DIR="/workspaces/tw_price_comparer/.claude/logs/$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" && mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" && jq -r '"[" + (now | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) + "] " + .tool_name + (if .tool_input.description then " (" + .tool_input.description + ")" else "" end) + " | " + (if .tool_input.command then .tool_input.command elif .tool_input.file_path then .tool_input.file_path elif .tool_input.pattern then ("pattern=" + .tool_input.pattern) else (.tool_input | tojson | .[0:200]) end)' >> "$LOG_DIR/command.log" 2>/dev/null || true
